description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which wraps the Android Log utility to implement a logging node interface, enabling chaining of log outputs within an application.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that implements LogNode interface to wrap Android's native logging for chained log processing.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs data using Android's Log, optionally appending stack trace info if an exception is provided, then forwards the log to the next node.
